name: smwgraphics-the-jungle-book-the-tree-village
title: The Jungle Book - The Tree Village
description:
A foreground and background tileset used in level 4 and 5 in The Jungle Book for the SNES. Credit isn't required if you use this, but it would be appreciated.

Note: This tileset contains background tileset. However, most of the included background is made up of the foreground tiles, with the exception of the trees.

Note: Those trees in the background could potentially be used as a layer 3 background just like it was in The Jungle Book if you know how to use custom layer 3 images.
